questions.question: A car travels 0.875 km in 1 minute. How far does it travel in 1 hour 45 minutes?
questions.questionHtml: A car travels 0.875 km in 1 minute. How far does it travel in 1 hour 45 minutes?
questions.solution:
• Speed = 0.875 km/min

• Time = 1 hour 45 min

• = 60+45 = 105 minutes

• Distance = Speed × Time

• = 0.875 × 105 = 91.875 km

questions.question: The expenditure of a household on food, clothing, and entertainment is in the ratio 2 : 4 : 4. In the coming year, the cost of food is expected to fall by 10%, clothing to rise by 5%, and entertainment to fall by 15%. What is the percent change (increase or decrease) in the total household expenditure?
questions.questionHtml: The expenditure of a household on food, clothing, and entertainment is in the ratio 2 : 4 : 4. In the coming year, the cost of food is expected to fall by 10%, clothing to rise by 5%, and entertainment to fall by 15%. What is the percent change (increase or decrease) in the total household expenditure?
questions.solution:
• Ratio food:clothing:entertainment = 2:4:4, Total = 10 parts

• Let total expenditure = 100

• Food = 20, Clothing = 40, Entertainment = 40

• New Food = 20 × 0.9 = 18

• New Clothing = 40 × 1.05 = 42

• New Entertainment = 40 × 0.85 = 34

• New Total = 18+42+34 = 94

• Change = 94-100 = -6 → 6% decrease

questions.question: A right circular cone has a radius of 7 cm and height of 24 cm. What is the slant height?
questions.questionHtml: A right circular cone has a radius of 7 cm and height of 24 cm. What is the slant height?
questions.solution:
• Slant height formula: l = √(r² + h²)

• r = 7 cm, h = 24 cm

• l = √(7² + 24²)

• = √(49 + 576)

• = √625 = 25 cm

• (This is a 7-24-25 Pythagorean triple)

questions.question: A triangular prism has base area of 25 cm². If height is increased by 20%, what is the new volume (original height was 10 cm)?
questions.questionHtml: A triangular prism has base area of 25 cm². If height is increased by 20%, what is the new volume (original height was 10 cm)?
questions.solution:
• Volume of prism = Base Area × Height

• Original Volume = 25 × 10 = 250 cm³

• New height = 10 × 1.2 = 12 cm

• New Volume = 25 × 12 = 300 cm³
